# SimOptix

The instructions for coding agents are seven skills in `.agents\skills\`, as `AGENTS.md` says:
- Before any work, read `.agents\skills\dev\SKILL.md` in full and follow it.
- Before writing anything that is committed, pushed or posted, read
  `.agents\skills\public-text\SKILL.md`.
- Before writing or changing docs, read `.agents\skills\docs\SKILL.md`.
- Before writing, changing or reviewing code, read `.agents\skills\code-style\SKILL.md` and
  `.agents\skills\code-practices\SKILL.md`.
- Before writing a commit message, or opening or editing a pull request, read
  `.agents\skills\pull-requests\SKILL.md`.
- Before writing or editing an issue or a comment, read `.agents\skills\issues\SKILL.md`.

This file only points at the skills. Change the rules there.
